name: Transaction Details 159
definition: Identifies the details of the transaction.

AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Owner Transaction Identification
AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account owner (or the instructing party managing the account).

AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Servicer Transaction Identification
AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account servicer.

MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.name: Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.definition: Identification of a transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the processor of the instruction other than the account owner, the account servicer and the market infrastructure.

OtherTransactionIdentification.name: Other Transaction Identification
OtherTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of a transaction that cannot be identified using a standard reference element present in the message.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

TransactionDetails.name: Transaction Details
TransactionDetails.definition: Provides additional details on the transaction which can not be included within the structured fields of the message.

TransactionIdentificationPresenceRule.definition: If AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification is NONREF then at least one of the other references must be present.

NoAccountOwnerTransactionIdentificationR.definition: If no reference is available for the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification, then the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification must be NONREF.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Ru.definition: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
